messages:
Maria (CS): Heads-up — ParcelQuik submitted a formal onboarding ticket asking for a multilingual (EN/ES/FR) summarizer. They require Dedicated capacity behind a private VPC and HSM-managed keys. Main constraints: PII redaction, deterministic summaries for audit trails, and a p95 latency target of ~200ms.
Sam (ParcelQuik): Correct. We need the summarizer to redact phone numbers, emails, and customer IDs, and produce short, reproducible summaries (80-ish tokens) for compliance reviewers. Can Redwood enforce deterministic decoding and a redaction pass?
Tia (Solutions Eng): @Maria can you confirm expected traffic shape and typical document size? Also, do they expect bursty ingest or steady throughput?
Maria (CS): Traffic: ~8 qps baseline, spikes to ~40 qps during peak windows. Typical input ~550–650 tokens; desired summary length 70–100 tokens. They asked for us-west deployment. HSM required for key rotation policy.
Xiang (ML Safety): Two-stage approach recommended: 1) a lightweight PII detector + redactor (runs first, on-host) 2) deterministic summarizer model with sampling disabled (greedy/beam=1). Need labeled eval set for redaction metrics. Determinism tests must be part of the safety rubric.
Tia (Solutions Eng): With 600-token inputs and ~80-token outputs, hitting 200ms p95 is hard on a single 7B instance. Options: smaller effective context via prefix trimming, aggressive kv-cache reuse, provision larger GPU (A10x+), or add replicas behind a very small batching window (but batching increases latency). I'll run perf sims and sizing.
Sam (ParcelQuik): We'd prefer not to compromise on determinism. Also can you provide an eval harness so we can validate redaction recall/precision before signing up for Dedicated? Renewal for pilot in 9 months — want to avoid surprises.
Maria (CS): Noted — renewal flagged. If onboarding slips we'll mark medium renewal risk and propose accelerated success plan. Action items I mapped: (1) Tia: perf sims + sizing; (2) Xiang: draft safety eval checklist + seed labels; (3) Maria: schedule kickoff and collect compliance spec. I'll loop in support for HSM setup.
Tia (Solutions Eng): Perf sim plan (example): run bench with quantized 7B variant, batch size 1, measure tail with replicas=3. Rough command I'll use: 
``
./bench --model redwood-7b-q --input parcelquik_sample.json --batch-size 1 --max-seq 700 --replicas 3
```
I'll post bench numbers by EOD Friday.
Xiang (ML Safety): Draft safety checklist highlights: token-level PII detection precision/recall, redaction FP/FN counts on edge cases, determinism (repeat run identity), and downstream compliance agreement score. I'll prepare a 150-item seed set for review.
Deploy Bot: Ticket created: DS-4729 (parcelquik_summarizer_onboard) assigned to tia_se, xiang_ml, maria_cs.
Sam (ParcelQuik): Can we do a 30-min kickoff next week? Tue/Wed morning PST preferred. Also we'll upload 1k sample transcripts for the eval.
Maria (CS): Kickoff scheduled Tue 9:30am PST. Invite sent. Please upload sample transcripts and the compliance spec to the shared folder: https://redwood.workspaces/parcelquik/onboard (upload by EOD tomorrow if possible).
Tia (Solutions Eng): I'll include the set of perf/config knobs we'll try: kv-cache warmup, beam=1, disable sampling, and quantization profiles. Also will test prefilter trimming heuristics to reduce effective context.
Xiang (ML Safety): I'll make a template for labeling PII edge cases and include instructions for deterministic test runs (same seed/inputs -> identical outputs).
Maria (CS): AM: please flag account for possible accelerated success plan if initial metrics miss targets. @ceo-sales FYI.
Sam (ParcelQuik): Thanks — will upload samples tonight. Appreciate the quick response.
Maria (CS): Thanks all :thumbsup: We'll reconvene after Tia posts perf sims and Xiang's safety checklist.
